faqs.question: Do you provide home addition construction services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Galactic Builders accepts home addition construction requests involving new room additions, extended living space, second-story additions, and structural construction connected to the existing home. The team must review your required work before confirming the scope.

faqs.question: What does home addition construction typically include?
faqs.answer: Home Addition Construction requests can include new room additions, extended living space, second-story additions, and structural construction connected to the existing home. Please describe what you would like done so the team can confirm the scope.

faqs.question: Do you handle both installation and repair for home addition construction?
faqs.answer: Additions involve new construction including foundation, framing, roofing, and finishing work tied into the existing structure.

faqs.question: How much does home addition construction cost?
faqs.answer: Galactic Builders does not display fixed service prices because every project depends on its scope, location, access, materials, condition, and required work. Select Request an Estimate, choose the service, and submit your contact and project details. Our consultant will reach you as soon as possible.

faqs.question: How long does home addition construction take?
faqs.answer: The schedule depends on project scope, material availability, permits, existing conditions, and required trades. The team can discuss an estimated schedule after reviewing the project.

faqs.question: What materials are used for home addition construction?
faqs.answer: Common addition materials include foundation materials, framing lumber, roofing, siding, and interior finishes.

faqs.question: Can I supply my own materials or fixtures?
faqs.answer: If you have architectural plans or material preferences already prepared, share them so the team can review against the project.

faqs.question: What should the team know about the current condition of the space?
faqs.answer: The team will need to review lot size, existing structure, utility access, and permit requirements before confirming scope.

faqs.question: Do you have architectural plans, and is this a single-story or multi-story addition?
faqs.answer: Home additions typically require plans and permits. Let the team know if you already have drawings or need help identifying next steps.

faqs.question: Can I upload photos of the project area?
faqs.answer: Yes. You may securely upload photos of the current space, any damage, measurements, or design inspiration to help the team understand your request.

faqs.question: Do you service my area?
faqs.answer: Galactic Builders serves South Bend, Indiana and nearby areas. Share your city and ZIP code and the team will confirm whether your location is within the service area.

faqs.question: Can I request a callback or consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request a callback or book a consultation, and a team member will follow up using your preferred contact method and time.

faqs.question: Are there any safety concerns I should mention?
faqs.answer: If there is an active safety issue such as gas odor, electrical sparking, active flooding, or a structural concern, let the team know immediately so it can be flagged appropriately.

faqs.question: Is Galactic Builders licensed and insured for this work?
faqs.answer: Licensing and insurance details are confirmed by the Galactic Builders team directly and are not guaranteed through this chat. Ask the team for current licensing and insurance documentation.

faqs.question: What is the next step to move forward?
faqs.answer: The next step is to start an estimate request for home addition construction so the team can review your project details and follow up.
